g.text: Research Desk team: dispositions, the bounded revise cycle, and the human gate
first pass drafts from retrieved context on chain;
revise passes redraft against the Critic's feedback
verdict line mapped to an integer score on chain;
the sentinel short-circuits to score 5, no model call
approval: policy owner, quorum 1, no timeout
the run suspends here (runSuspended, exactly once);
the sentinel and unrecognized shapes pass through unarchived
output node: the run completes and the
caller receives the final token value
final node: the run ends in refusal
A disposition is a token-local label matched against
transition triggers before guards. firstMatch tries
0 accept first; the kernel evaluates its compare guard
over the JSON observation. #1 revise is unconditional in
the definition — the bracket shows loop.maxIterations = 3,
lives in the token's execution context.
Up to 3 revise traversals occur; exhaustion is not a
traversal but a rewrite of the disposition to
No timeout is declared, so no timedOut route exists:
the gate waits indefinitely for a signed approve or
reject command carrying a globally unique decision id.
Only the gate's completed route reaches Archive: the
0 accept edge routes Decide straight to Answer, so
accepted model output can never re-enter the retrieval
corpus. Combined with the sentinel pass-through, the
Archivist files exactly the human-authored answers.
The archive node declares the team's only retry policy
(3 attempts, backoff 10 s then 30 s) because ChromaDB
/ token minted at the initial node
when the revise bound is exhausted)
/ null payload preserves the token value;
